description: This file defines the NameDeprecation class in the Twig library, representing deprecation information for named nodes or attributes within Twig's node system.

classes.name: NameDeprecation
classes.description: Represents a deprecation for a named node or attribute on a Node, containing information about the package, version, and new name associated with the deprecation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the deprecation with package, version, and new name.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Returns the package associated with the deprecation.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version when the deprecation was introduced.

methods.name: getNewName
methods.description: Returns the new name that replaces the deprecated node or attribute.
